name: state
meaning: 0 intact/idle, 1 kill received (start breaking), 2 break animation running. Reset does NOT clear it, which is half of the checkpoint defect.

name: camera
meaning: PROPERTY_ICEGROUND_IDCAMERA (0): the scripted camera record played while the ice breaks; NULL means no cutaway.

name: broken
meaning: 1 once the break animation has finished. While set, HandleMessage returns 0 at 0x4cc368 for EVERY message, so the tile answers no more ground queries and cannot be re-broken. Cleared by PostLoadInit and Reset.
